intro: Your friend wants to meet this Sunday. Agree on a plan together.

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: Are you free on Sunday? I was thinking we could do something.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say whether you are free and suggest something.
expected: Yes, I am free. How about going to the park?
Yes, I am free on Sunday. Shall we watch a film?
I am free. We could go cycling.
conversation.hint: Try: "Yes, I am free. How about going to the park?"

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: Hmm, I went to the park last week. Could we do something else?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: Then let us visit the market instead.

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: That sounds much better! What time shall we meet?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: Let us meet at four o'clock.
How about ten in the morning?
conversation.hint: Try: "Let us meet at four o'clock."

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: Four is a little late for me. Could we make it earlier?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Agree politely and suggest an earlier time.
expected: Of course, let us meet at two.
That is fine, how about two o'clock?
No problem, we can meet earlier.
conversation.hint: Try: "Of course, let us meet at two."

conversation.speaker: friend
conversation.text: Perfect. I will wait for you near the gate.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Confirm the plan and say goodbye.
expected: All right, see you at two.
